nodes.label: Three build flavors (pos/kiosk/display) sharing one codebase
nodes.rationale: One Dart codebase branches on a single appMode const set via --dart-define=APP_MODE so all three Android product flavors share every line of Dart code, differing only in home screen, orientation, and applicationIdSuffix.

nodes.label: Device identity & pairing handshake
nodes.rationale: Deliberately no offline fallback: a device that can't reach Convex sits on PairingScreen forever rather than pretending to be usable, and the device token itself is never persisted to disk so a revoked device is forced to re-pair rather than silently limping along on a dead token.

nodes.label: SoftPay AppSwitch payment integration
nodes.rationale: Card payments hand off to a separate Softpay app on-device via AppSwitch SDK; TRANSACTION_INCOMPLETE is worded as 'check' not 'retry' because a blind retry risks double-charging, and is recorded as its own 'unconfirmed' status rather than coerced to paid/failed.

nodes.label: TCS-D fiscalization (SKVFS 2020:9 compliance)
nodes.rationale: Flutter never builds VAT bands, never calls a raw TCS action, and never writes any fiscal record itself - it reports only the raw outcome of a real SoftPay charge/refund to a single centralized backend function (posPayments:reportEvent) so the certificate/passphrase never appears in the app.

nodes.label: The real charge flow (createOrder -> SoftPay -> reportChargeAndFiscalize)
nodes.rationale: Durable payment recording happens before any fiscal call so a device going offline right after a charge can never lose or duplicate a fiscal record; on a clean fiscal rejection the app auto-refunds via SoftPay so a customer is never charged for an unregisterable sale.

nodes.label: OrderEventOutbox disk-backed retry queue
nodes.rationale: Persists each report with a fresh idempotency key to SharedPreferences before attempting to send, so an app kill or dropped connection between a successful SoftPay charge and the mutation reaching Convex can't lose the report; ClientError_ConvexError (a genuine application-level rejection) is dropped and rethrown immediately rather than silently retried like a transient failure.

nodes.label: X-report / Z-report (SKVFS 2014:9 Ch.7 compliance)
nodes.rationale: X-report is a live running total since the last Z-report; a Z-report is a formal, numbered, immutable close-of-day event that only advances via an explicit staff-triggered 'Generate Z-report' action, never recomputed silently.

nodes.label: Journal (fiscal transaction log)
nodes.rationale: Software-side answer to the compliance requirement that the register show/export its transaction log to a tax inspector on demand; includes even sale attempts that never reached fiscalization, shown as 'Failed sale'.

nodes.label: Report export to external app-scoped storage
nodes.rationale: Deliberately writes to getExternalStorageDirectory()'s app-scoped Reports/ folder rather than the cache directory (OS-clearable, semantically temporary) or the documents directory (wiped on uninstall, invisible outside the app) - a fiscal record staff may need to hand a tax inspector must survive both and be reachable via file manager/USB-MTP/adb pull with no runtime storage permission required.

nodes.label: Customer-facing secondary display (dual Flutter engine bridge)
nodes.rationale: Runs as its own separate Flutter engine/isolate and deliberately never initializes a Convex client, since order creation and payment reporting must be driven only from the primary/cashier engine that has Convex access - wiring the secondary engine's dead startCharge path naively would reintroduce a charge-with-no-Convex-record bug.

nodes.label: Shared theming across primary and customer-display engines
nodes.rationale: Appearance is one config per restaurant, pushed from the admin dashboard and applied via applyRemote() on every whoAmI response rather than being locally editable/persisted, so both engines always share one visual language.

nodes.label: Known issue: convex_flutter 3.0.1 requires manual cargokit/Gradle patches
nodes.rationale: convex_flutter's Rust FFI native layer (cargokit) fails to build on Gradle 9.1.0 for two unrelated reasons (removed Project.exec(), and compileSdkVersion too low); patches are applied directly to the local pub cache, not vendored into the repo, so any new machine/CI runner needs them reapplied.

nodes.label: Known issue: flutter_rust_bridge version mismatch
nodes.rationale: convex_flutter 3.0.1 declares a loose ^2.11.1 range but its generated Rust bindings are only valid against exactly 2.11.1; without a pin, pub resolves a newer release and the app throws a codegen/runtime version mismatch at startup. Fixed via a dependency_override, tracked in git.

nodes.label: README pointer to plan.md's Deferred Practice/Proforma section
nodes.rationale: Test cases 9-10 (Practice/Proforma receipts) are not reachable from the real app - the raw TCS-D actions exist and work server-side but nothing calls them except a standalone dev test script; deliberately deferred since sales has no current plan for a Test/Training mode.
